analysis.investment_thesis: A promising small-cap defense play with 45%+ revenue CAGR, strong promoter holding (68%), and exposure to India's multi-lakh-crore indigenization opportunity. But at 73x P/E with negative OCF in 3 of last 4 years, the market has already priced in perfection — SMILE framework flags valuation and cash conversion as major concerns.
key_strengths: Revenue 47→146 Cr (45.8% CAGR), EBITDA margin expanded to 28% — genuine operational leverage
Promoter holding 68%, FII/DII <1% — undiscovered and skin-in-the-game intact
Aerospace & Defense TAM >1 lakh crore with <15% indigenous penetration — textbook 'E' of SMILE
key_risks: P/E 73x and P/B 10.9x — no margin of safety; even flawless execution may not beat entry price
Operating CF negative 3 of last 4 years (-3, -27, -9 Cr); FCF -8 Cr in FY25 despite 24 Cr PAT — working capital bloat typical of defense receivables
Market cap 1,516 Cr sits at top of my small-cap sweet spot; rerating room is limited from here
red_flags: Accounting profit not converting to cash — PAT 24 Cr vs OCF -3 Cr in FY25
Equity jumped 25→126 Cr in FY24 (dilution/QIP) — watch promoter % trend going forward
analysis.detailed_analysis:
This ticks several SMILE boxes beautifully: small size (1,516 Cr), large aspiration in defense indigenization, extra-large TAM, and a hungry promoter with 68% skin-in-the-game. Revenue quadrupling from 47 Cr to 146 Cr in three years with EBITDA margin climbing to 28% and ROCE of 23.65% tells me the business model works and operational leverage is real. Low institutional ownership (FII 0.01%, DII 0.66%) means this is still genuinely undiscovered — my favorite hunting ground.

But entry price matters enormously for small-caps, and 73x P/E with 10.9x P/B leaves no margin. More troubling for me is cash: OCF was -27 Cr in FY24 and -3 Cr in FY25, with cumulative FCF of -65 Cr over four years funded by 59 Cr of equity in FY24. Defense contracts are working-capital hungry, but I want to see the accrual profits convert before paying a premium. I'd keep this on the watchlist and buy aggressively on a 30-40% correction or when OCF turns decisively positive — the 10x story is plausible over a decade, just not from today's price.
